title: Canonical Audio Source, Asset, Cue & Soundscape Schema
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-26 America/Chicago after fresh verification of AIOC main 7e68d898b3ef1fb73ca748596f633e588b26d001 and application main b39770127e10f6fb7b364847d22d1a594e822770, re-reading the AAI program/backlog, AAI-01 completed checkpoint and AAI-01 closeout, then resolving the bounded AAI-02 schema/persistence/validation contract before branch creation.
objective: Define and prove a provider-neutral canonical audio contract for providers, sources, assets, semantic intent, cues, soundscapes, mixes and playlists while preserving AAI-01 capability/license evidence, explicit fail-closed rights/capability states and all existing gameplay-owner boundaries. This tranche defines schema and deterministic validation only; it does not implement provider adapters, authentication/catalog access, playback, semantic resolution, workbench UI or runtime owner integration.

identity.rule: All AAI-02 records carry stable explicit string IDs unique within their record kind. IDs are Multiversal references, not provider catalog IDs. Provider identity, provider asset/reference identity and semantic audio intent remain separate.
identity.provider_reference_rule: ProviderReference may carry an external/provider-native identifier or control reference but never promotes it to canonical Multiversal gameplay identity or implies content ownership.

provider.rule: Provider records reference AAI-01 evidence only; no secrets, live tokens, authenticated catalogs or inferred capabilities are stored.

source.rule: A source describes where audio may be referenced or supplied. File possession/provider availability does not imply rights.

asset.rule: Commercial provider content remains referenced/controlled; AAI-02 does not copy or acquire bytes.

intent.rule: Semantic intent is presentation/support metadata and remains separate from provider/source/asset identity and from canonical World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action identity.

cue.rule: AAI-02 stores declarative cue intent/manual/silence state only; no resolver or playback automation runs.

soundscape.rule: Layers are declarative references with stable ordering and gain intent only; playback/layering behavior belongs to AAI-04.

mix_preset.rule: Mix data is declarative volume/mute intent only; no mixer engine is implemented.

playlist.rule: Playlist ordering is deterministic metadata only; playback scheduling is not implemented.

rights_evidence.rule: Unknown is not allowed. Rights/capability states are explicit evidence and never inferred from possession, availability or another granted operation.

compatibility.rule: AAI-02 reuses AAI-01 capability states and cannot upgrade unsupported/unknown/provider-contact-required states by inference.

determinism.rule: Validation and preview serialization use stable record-kind order, explicit array order where authored, and stable ID sorting only for unordered diagnostic projections. Platform-specific timing, paths and provider responses are excluded from deterministic receipts.

owner_boundaries.rule: AAI-02 records may reference stable owner IDs but may not mutate owner state, create gameplay truth or infer canonical World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action identity from audio metadata.

persistence.result: No durable runtime audio ledger is required for AAI-02. Repository TypeScript contracts plus deterministic starter/integration evidence are sufficient. Runtime persistence remains a later separately justified concern.

nonauthorization: provider adapters or capability negotiation runtime
provider authentication or live catalog access

validation_contract.focused: Prove canonical record-kind coverage, stable identity/reference validation, explicit rights/capability fail-closed states, provider/asset/intent separation, unresolved/silent/manual cue states, owner nonmutation, no provider runtime/acquisition and no migration 0022 reservation.
validation_contract.predecessors: Run AAI-01 completed survey/authority verifier and MIB-11/D18 World-owner regression on both required platforms.
validation_contract.workflow: Register AAI-02 in canonical Repository Health path coverage and self-hosted Validation Core discovery without introducing a provider network dependency.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows AAI-02 Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison and declared predecessor/owner regressions before merge.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01 remains completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-02 authority is schema/contract/evidence only on its governed branch
audio intent remains separate from provider identity and provider asset/reference identity
no provider/catalog is canonical and unsupported/unknown capability remains explicit and fail closed
commercial provider audio remains controlled/referenced rather than copied absent explicit license
user-owned file possession does not infer redistribution/public-performance/commercial rights
Pocket Bard scraping/reverse engineering restrictions and Tabletop Audio SoundPad site-bound restrictions remain binding evidence
missing/disabled audio never blocks play and silent/unresolved/manual are first-class schema states
no provider acquisition/download/authentication/scraping/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation
